title: Choose the visual world for Spanda By Cura
question: The roll assigned The Stepwell. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Stepwell
options.lineage: Indian stepwells (baori / vav): carved sandstone galleries ringing one shaft of still water
options.thesis: Every discipline is a gallery ringing one patient at the centre, and recovery is the climb back up, step by step.
options.viewport: Looking down into a Three.js stepwell: GSAP parallax terraces, each carved with one care area, ring still water holding the headline, with Call and WhatsApp right in the centre.
options.risk: Could read as heritage tourism if the care facts don't land in the first lines; WebGL depth must have a light fallback for low-end Android.

raised.raise: Every control state comes from the stone: pressed steps sink, the active level catches sunlight, disabled stays in shadow.
One type family carries every level; hierarchy comes from scale and case alone.
Each care area is a numbered level with a carved marker, a wayfinding system that carries over to the inner pages.
A strict hairline grid holds the facts and the care-team roster; nothing floats.
Every therapy carries a tag saying who leads it and whether it runs inpatient or outpatient.
The centre of the well stays empty and calm, standing for the patient, while the disciplines ring it.

options.label: The Handloom
options.lineage: Indian handloom weaving: warp, weft, and indigo, madder and turmeric dyes
options.thesis: Each discipline is a coloured thread, and one team weaves them into a single cloth for each patient.
options.viewport: The logo's ribbons become Three.js threads that weave across the screen into cloth behind the headline, each thread named for a care area.
options.risk: The most familiar Indian-wellness move; risks reading as a crafts or boutique brand.

options.label: Design Annual Plate Section
options.thesis: Each care area is a registered plate on uncoated stock.
options.viewport: A plate grid of care areas with a rotating attribution stamp.
options.case: Fuses cleanly but needs photography Spanda doesn't have, and families don't recognise themselves in it.
options.risk: Cold, gallery-like distance for people in crisis.
options.kept: A strict hairline grid for facts and the roster.

options.label: Moon-Shadow Bazaar
options.thesis: Therapies laid out as stalls along a moonlit lane.
options.viewport: A night lane of therapy stalls.
options.case: Too uncanny for frightened families; a market muddies clinical credibility.
options.risk: Reads as dreamlike rather than trustworthy.
options.kept: Every therapy tagged with who leads it and the setting.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.viewport: A glowing disk with care areas on concentric rings.
options.case: An irreversible black hole is the wrong image for recovery.
options.kept: An empty, calm centre with disciplines ringed around it.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.case: Older Indian families don't identify with retro computing; it's playful where trust is needed.
options.kept: Every state expressed in one material.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: Care described as a typed transcript.
options.viewport: A blinking cursor printing care areas.
options.case: Cold and technical; unreadable for older visitors.
options.kept: One type family; hierarchy by scale and case.

options.label: Starship Crew Terminal
options.thesis: The center as a ship's deck plan.
options.viewport: Typed caps readouts with hazard pictograms.
options.case: Hazard language is alarming in a care context.
options.kept: Numbered, coded wayfinding for every zone.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean multi-specialty hospital site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A headline and appointment button beside a soft visual, with a row of service cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other clinic by design.
